sealed_statement.single_force: Let P=(G,S,X0,X,Y0,Y,f) be a source-valid current final state satisfying source axioms (i)-(iv), let u belong to X union Y, let c belong to the exact admissible palette A(u), and use the sealed fact that u is complete or anticomplete to every connected residual Y0 component. Then the construction S'=S union {u}, X0'=X0, X'=X minus {u}, Y0'=Y0 minus N(u), Y'=(Y minus {u}) union (Y0 intersect N(u)), f'=f union {u->c} is a syntactic normal subcase, satisfies source axioms (i)-(iv), and is extendable iff P has an extension with u=c.
sealed_statement.pair_force: Let u,v belong to X union Y, uv be a nonedge, and c belong to A(u) intersect A(v). Then the analogous construction with S''=S union {u,v} and Y0''=Y0 minus (N(u) union N(v)) is a syntactic normal subcase, satisfies source axioms (i)-(iv), and is extendable iff P has an extension with u=v=c.
sealed_statement.whole_component_residual: After either construction, the new residual Y0 is a union of whole old connected Y0 components; no old residual component is split.
sealed_statement.R2_identity: R2_P(u,v,c) equals the existential predicate obtained by first fixing u=c and then asking whether v=c is reachable in that forced state. This is a logical identity only.

source_exact_axiom_numbering.ii: S connected and no outside vertex complete to S
source_exact_axiom_numbering.iii: Y0 canonical as vertices outside S union X0 anticomplete to S
source_exact_axiom_numbering.iv: no vertex outside Y0 union X0 mixed on an edge of Y0

proof_core.i: G and X0 do not change.
proof_core.ii: Every forced vertex in X union Y has an old seed neighbor; seed enlargement preserves connectedness. Completeness to the enlarged seed would imply completeness to the old seed.
proof_core.iii: Residual vertices are exactly old Y0 vertices nonadjacent to every newly forced vertex.
proof_core.iv: Old outside vertices inherit old non-mixing; forced vertices are anticomplete to retained components; old Y0 vertices moved out lie in whole removed components and are anticomplete to distinct retained components.
proof_core.semantics: The graph is unchanged and the only new constraint is the explicit forced assignment, so extension equivalence is exact.

explicit_nonclaims: No theorem that the raw forced state satisfies source axiom (v).
No theorem that the raw forced state satisfies source axiom (vi).
No theorem that the forced state returns to the current authoritative final hard class.
No polynomial algorithm for R1 or R2.
